goal: Preserve 707 slow-motion feel while reusing the proven 668/683 fast-motion paths for Recent, Music Note, Library and outer resize.
changes: Added velocity hysteresis: fast enter >= 0.85 px/ms; slow return <= 0.38 px/ms sustained for 90ms.
Recent fast motion reuses the 668/683 legacy preview-divider plus adaptive pane commit path.
Music Note/Library fast motion reuses the 668/683 Lite one-pointer-target + one-rAF + one-real-boundary path.
Fast outer resize bypasses synthetic bounded-gap pacing and applies the real stored split ratio directly, matching 668/683 ownership.
Slow motion retains the current close-gap/prediction/hysteresis behavior from 707.
